purpose: Teach: デイトレード/圏内/屈指/約款/朗報/物的/司書/仕掛ける

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、社員のデイトレードは禁止だ
lines.en: Daytrade activities are forbidden for our employees.
lines.style: Measured authority. Brief, declarative. No softening. Eye level, chest open. The tone of someone who has already decided.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新店舗を商圏内に出店する計画です
lines.en: Understood. We're planning to open a new location within the market zone.
lines.style: Steady, deferential. Report-style cadence. Slight forward lean, attentive posture. Specific and unadorned.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、業界屈指の品質を目指せ
lines.en: We aim to be at the top of the industry in quality.
lines.style: Firm conviction. Weight on 「屈指」. Not asking, directing. Pause before the final phrase for emphasis.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。契約約款を最新化しました
lines.en: Understood. We've updated the contract terms to reflect current standards.
lines.style: Professional confirmation. Even tempo. Precise word choices. Shows the work done without overclaiming.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、お得意様への朗報を準備しろ
lines.en: Prepare good news to share with our key clients.
lines.style: Direct instruction, slightly warmer than the first order. Expectation of execution. Measured pace.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。物的証拠を整理しております
lines.en: Understood. We're currently organizing the documentation needed.
lines.style: Steady progress report. Quiet confidence. Slight emphasis on the present tense—work is already underway.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、社内図書室に司書を配置しろ
lines.en: Place a librarian in the company library.
lines.style: Clear directive. Deliberate, unhurried. Specific decision delivered without elaboration or hesitation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新商品の販促企画を仕掛けるタイミングです
lines.en: Understood. Now is the right timing to launch the promotional campaign for the new product.
lines.style: Closing affirmation with forward momentum. Slight lift at the end—recognizing the moment. Professional but warmer than earlier.
